title: Quantitative reconstruction from finite causal orders in a conformal diamond
description:
Post-certification revision of the quantitative reconstruction preprint by Daniel Eric Fredriksen, Quantyra Inc. Lean 4 now covers both polynomial and logarithmic inverse bounds, all-size identifiability, equality of directed labeled/unlabeled order-law total variation, and proper-time comparison for actual absolutely continuous future curves with one orientation shared by all endpoint pairs. The seven mathematical statement environments are unchanged from 0.3.1. Exact-source remote GCP acceptance audited 295 selected exports across the reconstruction and separate finite-data and higher-dimensional modules; this is not a claim that every exported theorem appears in this paper.

Winkler's coordinate forcing and stronger flat-model realizer recovery are credited. The candidate contribution remains explicit occupied-grid quantification and a uniform nonconstant-density inverse modulus; originality and optimal exponents remain provisional. Separate finite-data and genuine 2+1 Lorentzian modules do not supply new higher-dimensional inverse rates or physical nonidentifiability claims. Developed with OpenAI Codex assistance; open-source decentralized informal feedback and downstream testing remain the review workflow. CC-BY-4.0.
